verdict.rationale: Make's public Web API v2 has a real machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document, fetchable at a GitBook-hosted URL, and every API Reference page renders from it. However, Make's docs do not offer it as a download, and probes of the standard paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json) on developers.make.com all return 404, so an agent or user cannot easily find it. missing for 10: an officially linked, documented spec download on Make's own domain; a spec at conventional discoverable paths; independent or hands-on corroboration of using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Make's public Web API v2 is described by a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document
